opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. 28 U. S. C. § 1257 (2). Treating the papers whereon the appeal was allowed as a petition for writ of certiorari as required by *80628 U. S. C. § 2103, certiorari is denied.

Hayden C. Covington for appellants. W. S. Elkins and Leroy Jeffers for appellee.
